name: CA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's 6-point Democratic lean plus a favorable national environment
Bera's incumbency and large financial advantage ($1.8M cash vs $16K)
Markets price Bera at 95-96% to win
No public polling, leaving fundamentals as the main evidence
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Ami Bera: a D+6 district, an incumbent with a huge cash advantage over Robb Tucker, and prediction markets pricing his win odds at 95-96%. With no polling to contradict that picture, the race stays firmly in Safe D territory.
model.watch: Any late surge in Republican spending or unexpected polling showing a much tighter race would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Ami Bera, the Democratic incumbent, is heavily favored to win a seventh term in this Sacramento-area district. The seat leans Democratic by six points, and the political environment adds to that advantage. Bera has raised about $1.25 million and holds $1.8 million on hand, while Republican Robb Tucker has raised roughly $258,000 with only $16,000 remaining, leaving Tucker with little visible capacity to compete.

Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price Bera's chances at 95 percent or higher, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. No public general-election polling exists, so the forecast rests on fundamentals, fundraising, and market pricing, all of which point the same direction.
